findings.en_sentence: Miotadorna catrionae was synonymized with Miotadorna sanctibathansi by Tennyson et al. in 2022.
findings.es_sentence: Miotadorna catrionae fue sinonimizada con Miotadorna sanctibathansi por Tennyson y colaboradores en 2022.
findings.problem: Tennyson et al. (2022, Taxonomy 2:136-144) described and named M. catrionae; the taxobox 'synonyms' entry is its authority, not the synonymizer. The synonymy was proposed by Worthy et al. (2022, Zootaxa 5168).
findings.correct: Miotadorna catrionae was described by Tennyson et al. in 2022; later that year Worthy et al. considered it a synonym of M. sanctibathansi.
findings.checked_in: enwiki oldid 1341564654 taxobox + M. catrionae section refs; F002, F011

findings.en_sentence: M. catrionae is the largest duck species discovered in the St Bathans fossil deposits.
findings.es_sentence: M. catrionae es la especie de pato más grande descubierta en los yacimientos fósiles de St Bathans.
findings.problem: Presented as a valid species without caveat, while discovery and debate sections say it was synonymized with M. sanctibathansi; it is also mentioned here before being introduced anywhere (the page never says the genus has/had two species, F004 unused).
findings.correct: Introduce M. catrionae (Catriona's shelduck, described 2022) as the second named species, then say it is the largest duck so far from St Bathans if valid, noting its validity is disputed.
findings.checked_in: enwiki intro and M. catrionae section; F004, F007, F011

findings.en_sentence: The genus name Miotadorna indicates that the describers viewed the bird as a Miocene shelduck similar to modern Tadorna.
findings.es_sentence: El nombre del género Miotadorna indica que sus describientes consideraban al ave como un pato de la suerte (tadorno) del Mioceno similar al moderno Tadorna.
findings.problem: 'pato de la suerte' is a mistranslation of 'shelduck' (the Spanish name is 'tarro'); 'describientes' is not a Spanish word.
findings.correct: El nombre del género indica que sus autores consideraban al ave un tarro del Mioceno similar a los del género actual Tadorna.

findings.en_sentence: Miotadorna lived between 18.7 and 15.9 million years ago, spanning the Burdigalian to Langhian stages.
findings.es_sentence: Miotadorna vivió entre hace 18,7 y 15,9 millones de años, abarcando los pisos Burdigaliense y Langhian.
findings.problem: Stage name left in English ('Langhian' instead of 'Langhiense'); 'entre hace' is ungrammatical.
findings.correct: Miotadorna vivió hace entre 18,7 y 15,9 millones de años, del Burdigaliense al Langhiense.

findings.en_sentence: This bird belongs to the family Anatidae and is classified within the subfamily Tadorninae.
findings.es_sentence: Este ave pertenece a la familia Anatidae y se clasifica dentro de la subfamilia Tadorninae.
findings.correct: Esta ave pertenece a la familia Anatidae y se clasifica dentro de la subfamilia Tadorninae.

findings.en_sentence: Researchers suggest the size difference between M. catrionae and M. sanctibathansi may represent sexual dimorphism, though this explanation is not fully supported by the morphological evidence. Worthy et al. (2022) considered M. catrionae a synonym of M. sanctibathansi, believing the larger specimen represented a larger sex rather than a distinct species.
findings.es_sentence: Los investigadores sugieren que la diferencia de tamaño entre M. catrionae y M. sanctibathansi podría representar dimorfismo sexual, aunque esta explicación no está totalmente respaldada por la evidencia morfológica. Worthy y colaboradores (2022) consideraron a M. catrionae como un sinónimo de M. sanctibathansi, creyendo que el ejemplar más grande representaba un sexo más grande en lugar de una especie distinta.
findings.problem: 'un sexo más grande' is a literal calque of 'a larger sex'.
findings.correct: ...creyendo que el ejemplar mayor correspondía al sexo de mayor tamaño y no a una especie distinta.
